repository_universe.rule: Transitions MUST be drawn exclusively from the 25 frozen formal benchmark repositories.

transition_tuple_definition.temporal_ordering_invariant: base_commit MUST be a strict chronological git ancestor of target_commit (base_commit < target_commit). Non-ancestral or parallel branches are strictly excluded.

tier_1_release_tags.description: Consecutive or adjacent tagged stable releases on primary branch (e.g. v1.2.0 -> v1.3.0 or v1.2.0 -> v2.0.0).
tier_1_release_tags.filter: Exclude pre-releases (alpha, beta, rc, dev) unless standard release cycle of the repository.

tier_2_commit_milestones.description: Chronologically sampled non-merge commits on primary branch when tagged releases are unavailable or sparse.

technical_eligibility_gates.git_reachability: Both base_commit and target_commit must be fetchable and checkable out cleanly in a fresh git workspace.
technical_eligibility_gates.python_ast_parseable: Primary Python source files in both base and target trees must be parseable by standard Python 3 AST parser.
technical_eligibility_gates.environment_independence: Transitions must not require proprietary external hardware or unmockable network services for basic static AST / symbolic representation.

screening_separation_and_outcome_indepen.technical_screening_rule: Transitions may be rejected ONLY for objective technical reasons: commit missing, git checkout failure, source unavailable, AST syntax unparseable, or corrupt history.
screening_separation_and_outcome_indepen.prohibited_outcome_conditioning: Rejection or selection of transitions based on: (1) inspection of API diffs, (2) presence or absence of breaking changes, (3) claim difficulty, (4) lack of stale claims, or (5) RoleMem algorithm execution / predictions is STRICTLY FORBIDDEN.

transition_sampling_strategy.prng_engine: Python random.Random(seed=3407) with repository-keyed deterministic stream
sampling_steps: 1. Iterate through all 25 formal repositories in deterministic selection_rank order (Rank 1 to 25).
2. For repository R_i, enumerate all eligible candidate transitions T(R_i) satisfying Tier 1 (release tags) or Tier 2 (commit milestones).
3. Sort candidate transitions chronologically by (base_timestamp, target_timestamp, base_ref, target_ref).
4. Seed PRNG with seed = 3407 + selection_rank (or deterministic keyed hash) to shuffle the candidate transition list for R_i.
5. Select the top K_target = 2 transitions per repository sequentially from the shuffled candidate list (up to max K_max = 3).
6. Verify that selected transitions pass objective technical eligibility gates.
7. Aggregate all selected transitions into formal_transition_manifest.json.
transition_sampling_strategy.invariance_guarantee: Given the frozen 25 repositories, candidate release history, and seed 3407, the mined transition manifest is 100% mathematically deterministic and reproducible.

transition_metadata_schema.description: Strict schema for formal transition manifest. Enforces recording of transition metadata only, strictly prohibiting claim, diff, validity, staleness, or RoleMem outcome leakage.

field_specifications.transition_id: String: Opaque unique identifier (e.g. TR-001 to TR-050)
field_specifications.repository_name: String: Repository owner/name from formal selection
field_specifications.category: String: Functional category from formal repository selection
field_specifications.base_ref: String: Git release tag name or commit ref at base state
field_specifications.base_commit: String: 40-character hex commit SHA at base state
field_specifications.base_timestamp: String: ISO 8601 commit timestamp of base_commit
field_specifications.target_ref: String: Git release tag name or commit ref at target state
field_specifications.target_commit: String: 40-character hex commit SHA at target state
field_specifications.target_timestamp: String: ISO 8601 commit timestamp of target_commit
field_specifications.commit_distance: Integer: Non-merge commit count between base and target
field_specifications.temporal_distance_days: Float: Calendar days elapsed between base and target

prohibited_information_and_firewall.no_api_diff_inspection_before_selection: Transitions MUST be sampled strictly by release tag / chronological commit hierarchy before inspecting API diffs or symbol changes.
prohibited_information_and_firewall.no_outcome_conditioning: Sampling MUST NOT filter for or against breaking transitions, deprecations, or unchanged APIs.
prohibited_information_and_firewall.no_claim_creation: Phase S2 is restricted to transition discovery and metadata verification; zero claims may be constructed in Phase S2.
prohibited_information_and_firewall.no_gold_adjudication: Zero gold labels (VALID/STALE) may be assigned during transition mining.
prohibited_information_and_firewall.isolation_boundary: Memory Author (Phase S3) observes only base_commit; Target validity (Phase S4) observes target_commit only after claim freezing.
